sec: Atypical HUS Genetics, Drugs & Investigations · p754

items.q: In the coagulation line of the blood investigation block, what is stated as normal?
items.exp: The blood-investigation list runs: ↑LDH, -ve Coombs test, ↑indirect bilirubin, ↓haptoglobin level, Normal - PT/APTT — normal clotting helps distinguish TMA from DIC. (Book p754)

items.q: Match each sporadic drug-induced agent with the position of its listing — 1) Tacrolimus and cyclosporine 2) Ticlopidine and clopidogrel 3) Mitomycin … A) Grouped under calcineurin inhibitors B) Marked 'TTP also' C) The first bullet of the drug list D) Listed under immune-mediated HUS only
items.exp: The sporadic block lists mitomycin first, then gemcitabine and bevacizumab, then 'Calcineurin inhibitors: tacrolimus, cyclosporine', then ticlopidine and clopidogrel bracketed 'TTP also', and cisplatin; quinine, gemcitabine, quetiapine and cotrimoxazole form the separate immune-mediated list. (Book p754)

items.q: Gemcitabine appears twice in the causes diagram — once as a sporadic drug-induced agent and once under immune-mediated HUS.
opts: True — the same drug is printed in both lists
False — it appears only among calcineurin inhibitors
False — it appears only under immune-mediated HUS
True — and it is also the toxin of streptococcal neuraminidase
items.exp: Gemcitabine is the second bullet of 'Sporadic: Drug induced' and the second bullet of 'Immune mediated HUS' on the same page. (Book p754)

items.q: All of the following are printed under the sporadic drug-induced column EXCEPT:
items.exp: The drug column lists mitomycin, gemcitabine, bevacizumab, calcineurin inhibitors (tacrolimus, cyclosporine), ticlopidine, clopidogrel and cisplatin; rituximab appears only as post-transplant therapy on p755. (Book p754)
